This page demonstrates the `include-in-header` strategy for loading macros. The YAML front matter of this file includes:

```yaml
format:
  html:
    include-in-header:
      - macros.qmd
  pdf:
    include-in-header:
      - macros.qmd
  docx: default
```

> **Note:** `revealjs` is omitted from this demo page because a Quarto website page cannot simultaneously be a RevealJS presentation. To use `include-in-header` with RevealJS, add a `revealjs:` entry in a standalone `.qmd` file or in `_quarto.yml` (see the project-wide config below).

> **Note:** This demo uses `macros.qmd` because `macros.qmd` is at the root of this repository. When using this repository as a Git submodule (cloned into a `macros/` subdirectory), replace `macros.qmd` with `macros/macros.qmd`.

The same configuration can be placed in a shared `_quarto.yml` to apply project-wide:

```yaml
format:
  html:
    include-in-header:
      - macros/macros.qmd
  pdf:
    include-in-header:
      - macros/macros.qmd
  revealjs:
    include-in-header:
      - macros/macros.qmd
```

This inserts `macros.qmd` verbatim into the document header for each output format:

- **PDF**: definitions go into the LaTeX preamble — all macros work, including `\providecommand`.
- **HTML/RevealJS**: MathJax processes the header — MathJax-supported commands (`\def`, `\newcommand`, `\renewcommand`, `\let`, environments) are recognized; `\providecommand` is silently ignored. The example table below uses only `\def`-based macros.
- **docx**: Word documents do not use a LaTeX preamble or MathJax header, so `include-in-header` has no effect on math rendering for docx. The `docx: default` entry above produces docx output without macro support.

## Example math

The table below uses macros defined with `\def` in `macros.qmd`, which work in all output formats that support MathJax or LaTeX:

| Description | Code | Output |
|---|---|---|
| Greek: alpha | `$\a$` | $\a$ |
| Greek: beta | `$\b$` | $\b$ |
| Greek: gamma | `$\g$` | $\g$ |
| Greek: lambda | `$\l$` | $\l$ |
| Greek: sigma | `$\s$` | $\s$ |
| Log-likelihood | `$\llik$` | $\llik$ |
| Independent | `$X \ind Y$` | $X \ind Y$ |
| IID distributed | `$X_i \siid \Normal(\m, \ss)$` | $X_i \siid \Normal(\m, \ss)$ |
| Vector: mu | `$\vm$` | $\vm$ |
| Hat beta | `$\hb$` | $\hb$ |
